edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: He must commit E or R to reach you and either lands him in the cage — bait the hop, stun, and W-R deletes him.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Stacked Q makes the caged combo a one-shot — his all-in works only if he baits your E out first.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: Any Fizz who jumps on you dies to E-combo on landing — infinite AP forces him off you and onto the backline.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1 (8s max); the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, so bait it before spending burst. - Your E Event Horizon (20s at rank 1) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: The instant his hop is down and he dips below half, R him — the execute closes before a second Playful can save him.

edits.before: That is Fizz’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: His W wind-up auto is the combo tell — step back on it.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Q-W-auto burst kills from half HP the moment your cage is down — stacks aren't worth standing in his 550 dash window.
